# FilaScan 0.2.6

- Press Enter in the web setup security-code field to unlock the configuration.
- Prevent duplicate submissions while unlocking.
- Remove the inherited browser-tab icon from the configuration page.

## Installation

On 0.2.5, swipe upward from the bottom edge of the display, select the available
update and confirm installation. The protected web interface also supports OTA
installation. The merged ESP32-S3 image is available for USB recovery.
